5.eng-name: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: Rapporté par ‘Adi bin Thabit, de la part de son père : Quand le Prophète (ﷺ) montait sur le minbar, ses compagnons se tournaient vers lui

chapter.ara-name: باب مَا جَاءَ فِي اسْتِقْبَالِ الإِمَامِ وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.eng-name: What was narrated concerning facing the Imam when he is delivering the sermon
